_metadata.product_long_name: GPM IMERG Late Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07
_metadata.variable: precipitation (daily accumulated liquid-equivalent precipitation in mm)
_metadata.run_type: Late Run (calibrated microwave + IR multi-satellite, ~14-hour latency)
_metadata.final_run_note: Final Run is not available for the rolling-window dates (latest Final granule found: 2025-09-30); the rolling window therefore uses the Late Run. A separate full-history backfill would use Final through 2025-09-30 and Late thereafter.
_metadata.sampling: Nearest 0.1° IMERG grid cell to each district headquarters coordinate (docs/data/district_points.csv); no area aggregation.
_metadata.dimension_order_note: OPeNDAP request is precipitation[time][lon][lat]; the parser receives one row per longitude (48 rows) and 63 latitude values per row. District selection is arr[lon_index, lat_index], not arr[lat_index, lon_index].
